entries.decision: Exact non-Get PDF identifier may produce a warning in DMS V2.2 or explicitly selected V2.4 candidate context; it is never accepted as an alias.
guards: must resolve to GetDeviceStatusInformationResponseData according to selected schema
must not register DeviceStatusInformationResponseData as alias

entries.decision: Advisory is allowed only after official DMS V2.2 XSD rejects a DeviceStatusStructure missing DeviceStatusImpact or DeviceStatusPriority.
guards: must require XSD INVALID before advisory
must not modify payload or XSD result

entries.decision: Exact GetUpdateStates resolver/configuration input may be warned about; selected operation inventory remains GetUpdateHistory.
Exact singular GetDeviceErrorMessage in documentation-derived operation input may receive an informational correction to plural GetDeviceErrorMessages.
guards: must not change schema validation result
